instructions.title: Welcome to Access AI
instructions.visible_text: Welcome to Access AI. This setup works without sight. Accessible setup is beginning. Access AI will speak each step unless you choose screen-reader-only operation or stop Access AI speech.
instructions.speech: Welcome to Access AI. This setup works without sight. Accessible setup is beginning. I will speak each step unless you choose screen reader only operation or stop Access AI speech.

instructions.title: Choose setup guidance
instructions.visible_text: Choose continued Access AI spoken guidance or screen-reader-only operation. Access AI spoken guidance is selected by default.
instructions.speech: Choose your setup guidance. Continue Access AI spoken guidance, or use screen reader only operation. Access AI spoken guidance is currently selected. Then activate Continue.

instructions.title: 1 of 3 — Vision
instructions.visible_text: Choose Blind, Severe low vision, Low vision, Sighted caregiver, or Prefer not to say. Then activate Continue.
instructions.speech: Step 1 of 3, vision. Choose Blind, Severe low vision, Low vision, Sighted caregiver, or Prefer not to say. Then activate Continue.

instructions.title: 2 of 3 — Interaction
instructions.visible_text: Choose Voice first, Screen reader and keyboard, Refreshable Braille display, Large text, or Combination. Then activate Continue.
instructions.speech: Step 2 of 3, interaction. Choose Voice first, Screen reader and keyboard, Refreshable Braille display, Large text, or Combination. Then activate Continue.

instructions.title: 3 of 3 — Device and answers
instructions.visible_text: Choose your platform or screen reader, whether answers should be spoken automatically, and your preferred answer style. Then activate Finish setup.
instructions.speech: Step 3 of 3, device and answers. Choose your platform or screen reader, whether answers should be spoken automatically, and your preferred answer style. Then activate Finish setup.

instructions.title: Setup complete
instructions.visible_text: Access AI is ready. Camera assistance comes first, followed by voice input and text or Braille input. Voice controls remain available when Access AI speech is on.
instructions.speech: Setup complete. Access AI is ready. Camera assistance comes first, followed by voice input and text or Braille input. Voice controls remain available when Access AI speech is on.
